jobs.description: Are you an experienced Category C driver looking for a stable daytime job? Then this could be the perfect opportunity for you.Your workday starts around 7:00 AM with a short vehicle inspection. After that, you hit the road and drive your assigned route through different municipalities. You are responsible for operating the vehicle safely, following planned routes, and ensuring daily operations run smoothly.This position is focused on driving. You are hired as a truck driver, not as a waste collector. You'll work closely with your colleagues on the vehicle, while your main responsibility remains driving and keeping the route safe and efficient.As a driver, you:- Drive collection routes in the Alphen aan den Rijn and Moordrecht area- Carry out daily vehicle checks- Follow safety procedures and regulations- Communicate with colleagues and supervisors when needed- Help ensure a clean and safe living environmentYou will work an average of 32 hours per week, from Monday to Saturday. If you work on Saturdays, you will receive a 140% allowance. Most working days end around 4:00 PM, giving you a great work-life balance and evenings free.You enjoy being on the road, take responsibility for your work, and value safety.What you bring:- A valid Category C driving licence- A valid Code 95- Don't have Code 95 yet? Olympia can help you obtain it- A VCA certificate or willingness to obtain one within one month (free of charge)- Basic communication skills in English- Availability to occasionally work on Saturdays- Living in or near the Alphen aan den Rijn, Moordrecht, Gouda, Rotterdam or surrounding area is a plus

jobs.occupation: Assisting Housekeeping Supervisor - Hotel V Nesplein
jobs.description: Are you a bit of a neat freak, strong in leading others, and do you also enjoy getting work done yourself? Then come join our team as an Assisting Housekeeping Supervisor at Hotel V Nesplein!We are Conscious Group! Conscious Group consists of nine hotel, four Hotel V locations and five Conscious Hotels locations, and two restaurants. Here, hospitality, design, and sustainability come together. Conscious Hotels focuses on sustainability down to the smallest detail, without compromising on comfort. While Hotel V is known for its stylish, characterful, and authentically Amsterdam vibe. Within Conscious Group, all locations work together as one team, driven by our FOCAL values: Fun, Open, Connect, Ambition, and Love. And right now, Hotel V Nesplein is looking for an assisting housekeeping supervisor.Are you someone who gets going early in the morning, keeps a clear overview, has a keen eye for detail and likes to have a steady schedule? Then we're looking for you! We're searching for an Assisting Housekeeping Supervisor who not only leads the team but is also hands-on and ready to roll up their sleeves.Our housekeeping team is small and close, playing a key role in our guests' overall experience. Together with the team, you make sure every room and space is exactly right — fresh, well-kept, and finished down to the last detail. This means you have a direct impact on how guests experience their stay. You actively work on the floor, keep an overview, and jump in wherever needed. Early shifts or weekend work don't faze you, and you know how to go the extra mile for guests with a smile. If you live in Amsterdam and already have some hotel experience, that's a big plus.Functie-eisen:About you!• At least 2 years of experience in a similar role, preferably within a hotel environment;• Excellent command of both Dutch and English;• Able to lead an international housekeeping team while actively working alongside them on the floor;• Responsible for pla

As a warehouse employee at Zara in Utrecht, you work in the lively city center. What will you do?As a forklift driver, you play an essential role in our warehouse operations. You ensure that pallets filled with our beverages are placed in the right location in a safe and structured way. Once production is completed, you take over and carefully move goods throughout the warehouse.You will also support export activities, making sure our products are prepared correctly and reach international customers safely and on time.Your daily tasks- Using an on-board computer, you know exactly which pallets need to be moved and where they should go.- You prepare goods for shipment to customers around the world.- You work closely with your colleagues and always maintain a safe working environment.- You get the chance to learn different areas of the warehouse, with the order pool as your fixed base.Work Hours & FlexibilityIn this position, you’ll work rotating shifts. You’ll be scheduled flexibly based on staffing needs. This means that one day you might work an early shift, and the next a late or night shift. You’re always welcome to indicate a preference, but we do expect flexibility.Work Hours:- 08:00 – 16:30 hr- 09:30 – 18:00 hr- 06:00 – 14:00 hr- 14:00 – 22:00 hr- 22:00 – 06:00 hr (always in blocks of 4/5 nights)This is a temporary position through April 2027. We’re happy to help you discover and develop your talents!- You have a valid forklift certificate OR proven experience operating a forklift and are willing to obtain your certificate;- You have a good command of either Dutch or English;- You are willing to work part-time or full-time.
